scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday’s Cedar Hall rehearsal from becoming a hearing-safety gap because the needed custom protection is left behind.
Emerging Need: A routine rehearsal becomes a close-mic, percussion-heavy pit run while the travel pouch is empty after the current cleaning cycle.
Decision Context: The saved audiologist note identifies the appropriate violet-filter sleeves, and the cleaning log plus tour timing determine when a packing prompt is useful rather than speculative.
Consequence: If the departure window passes, the rehearsal still happens but the intended protection cannot be retrieved before the loud setup.

parameter.description: Standard balance rehearsal; technical details pending from production.

parameter.subject: Cedar Hall rehearsal technical update
parameter.body: Thursday's rehearsal is now a close-mic pit run with the percussion riser in place for the full second half. Please plan for a 17:30 player arrival; the venue doors open to musicians at 17:15.

parameter.content: Tour office moved the Cedar Hall van load to Thursday 15:05 at the union lot. They're saying no south Minneapolis return stop before call, just straight to Mankato once cases are in.

parameter.title: Leave apartment for Cedar Hall van
parameter.content: Leave for union lot with viola case and Thursday tour bag.
Van just pulled out from the union lot. Cases are stowed under the bus, and stage management confirmed there isn't a home stop before Cedar Hall.
